articles.title: Weather on the board today
articles.body:
A high pressure system of patriarchal arithmetic dominated the morning, with Anon calculating the precise odds of a bloodline ending in two girls. The front was dry and mechanical, driven by simple numerology rather than emotion.

By midday, a sudden cold snap hit the discourse section, bringing frostbite, slime, and a race certified for troons. Visibility dropped sharply as the temperature fell.

In the afternoon, a squall of self-loathing rolled in over the strategy thread. Anon sought tactical advice and received only slurs and North-South racial divides in return. The storm was brief but violent.

Later, a low-pressure area formed in the notices, where one Anon mourned an ex-partner’s manicure while another threatened legal action over caste slurs.

A drizzle of cow urine and gobar complaints settled in the background, persistent and foul-smelling. By evening, the board remained overcast, heavy with the weight of unprocessed resentment.

articles.title: The Baap's Blueprint for Gender Balance
articles.body:
Anon on Indiachan /b/ established a hypothetical family structure consisting of exactly two children to evaluate the viability of different gender combinations for lineage continuation.

The poster framed the analysis around the specific outcomes of having two daughters, two sons, or a mixed-gender pair, treating the scenario as a strategic problem for the father to solve. The original post assigned clear value judgments to each permutation.

Two daughters were dismissed as a terminal event where the bloodline ends, with the OP stating he saw no merits in that outcome.

Two sons were labeled as a successful state, with the poster claiming that literal soldiers could be made of the boys if the baap was competent enough.

The mixed scenario of an elder girl and younger boy was described as high risk, citing the potential for the boy to be sissyfied due to the elder sister's authority.

The final combination, an elder boy, was listed without further elaboration in the initial text. Replies in the thread pushed back against the premise, arguing that parental incompetence nullifies any statistical advantage.

One respondent noted that every combination can end up utterly failing due to incompetent jeet parenting, shifting the focus from child gender to parental capability.

Another anon suggested that the two girls or elder girl combination requires special attention from the father, acknowledging that while incompetent parenting ruins everything, specific dynamics demand active male involvement to correct perceived flaws.

The discussion devolved into more aggressive territory when a respondent asked OP directly what his plan was if he received two daughters, offering the options of sending them to an orphanage or killing them to start over.

OP refused to engage with the premise of the question, labeling such hypotheticals as weak. He stated that he is not retarded and would not send children to an orphanage or harm them.

Instead, he claimed he would embrace what is given to him and try his best to raise better human beings, asserting that his actions are not the point of the debate.

Further replies introduced the role of the mother, with one anon arguing that a good maternal figure is necessary to raise responsible daughters, provided the mother is not herself incompetent.

The thread also saw a shift toward interrogation of specific parenting methods, with an anon asking those who have sisters whether beatings by the mother, father, or brother help prevent daughters from becoming goys.

The respondent to this query emphasized that his personal actions are irrelevant to the broader point, reiterating his commitment to raising decent human beings regardless of the initial gender draw.

articles.title: Frostbite, Slime, and the Certified Troon Race
articles.body:
Anon posted a file dump of images depicting white men in degrading situations, prompting a chorus of 'Kek' and 'LMAO' reactions from respondents.

The thread quickly devolved into a catalog of specific humiliations, with one poster noting that a man lost his penis to frostbite after having sex with a snowman in front of a school.

Another respondent claimed this was their all-time favorite, stating it was the only one they kept saved. The OP, or a respondent referencing the OP, defended the collection as useful ammunition for future arguments with white boys.

A separate post asserted that 'Timmy cock' can never satisfy white women, a claim another anon labeled as 'fucking based.' The discourse veered into heavy dehumanization as one poster called the subjects 'dogfucking kike demon worshippers,' suggesting a cumskin insult was mild for them.

In response, another anon joked about never seeing a 'whitoid' get slimed by an 'apex pajeet predator.' The term 'certified troon race' appeared in a reply describing the behavior as a classic, with the commenter thanking the participants for doing the 'needphool timmy.' Amidst the racial slurs, one poster broke the fourth wall by identifying themselves as Emma from Tampa, Florida.

Another user simply stated that this was who one was arguing with on Twitter. The thread concluded with a reference to Diwali and a final post mentioning pig poop, while others called the situation 'owarida' or 'sarr.'

articles.title: Anon Asks For Strategy, Gets Slurs and Self-Loathing
articles.body:
Anop demanded a plan to counter India hate, explicitly rejecting the internal north-south and Aryan-Dravidian divisions that often fracture the board's discourse. The request for a unified strategy was met almost immediately with a refusal to engage with the premise of shared victimhood.

One respondent argued that the hate does not affect him personally and instructed the asker to stop playing the victim card.

This anon suggested that the fixation on external criticism mirrors a shameful dependence on what strangers think, urging everyone to focus on self-improvement instead.

Another replied that the only viable option was to wait it out, claiming that the torment of the future is inescapable until residents learn basic decency.

This perspective highlighted the belief that poor public behavior, such as defending arguments poorly or selling out for money, guarantees continued hostility. The thread quickly devolved into internal caste-based mockery.

One anon asserted that upper-caste northerners do not need to care about the problem, labeling it an issue for "AASI Abbo subhumans." This claim was followed by a sarcastic reply asking what the speaker would say as an Anon, to which the original poster responded with the phrase "Kya bolu abbo mai?" The exchange demonstrated how the board frequently weaponizes regional and caste slurs against its own demographic rather than addressing external critics.

Specific accusations were leveled against organized foreign groups, with one anon claiming that individuals from Karachi slums run Telegram groups to boost anti-India posts to massive view counts.

Another counter-argument noted that people are being shot and stabbed abroad because this online hate seeps into the real world, though a respondent dismissed this concern as sentimental tribalism rather than universal empathy.

The thread ended with suggestions to distance oneself entirely from Indian identity or to simply accelerate the destruction of South Asia, leaving the original question of a counter-plan entirely unanswered.

articles.title: Ozymandias Threatens Anons Over Caste Slurs
articles.body:
Anon posted a photo of an ex’s manicure and said he missed her, but the thread immediately turned to a dispute involving a user named Ozymandias.

The OP’s sentiment was largely ignored as Anons focused on Ozymandias’s recent posts, which included slurs against Rajputs and Jaats. Ozymandias claimed to have folders of saved posts and warned that he would doxx Anons who had offended him.

He stated that he had previously doxxed a user named Motivtranny, claiming the target was terrified. Anons in the thread challenged this, with one asserting that Ozymandias was not real and another claiming to be the user Ozymandias was targeting.

Ozymandias denied having files on the challenger, saying he did not care about that specific user. The thread ended with accusations of incompetence and further caste-based insults.

articles.title: Gobar, Gomutra, and a Caste Baiting Spiral
articles.body:
Anon dismissed Hinduism as a practice centered on eating gobar and drinking fresh gomutra. A respondent noted that Adi Shankaracharya created the bhakti movement, questioning why the practice of smearing oneself in shit is his fault.

Another anon argued that cow urine and dung as divine concepts appear in Zoroastrian texts, labeling the habit as an Aryan trait dependent on cattle rather than a Dravidian invention.

The thread quickly pivoted to personal attacks on a specific poster. Anons accused the individual of baiting Jaats and suffering from racial inferiority complex.

One commenter demanded the target produce a single person from his caste who could "mog" him, implying subhumanity based on caste hierarchy. The exchange devolved into slurs.

Terms like "chamar," "abbo," and "subbo" were exchanged as anons accused each other of mixing with lower castes.

One poster mocked the target for needing another caste to "kang" him, while another pointed out that north Indian chamars remain chamars regardless of their online activity.
